name: cursor-glow
prompt: A glow that follows the mouse cursor, Shadertoy style, over a subtle gradient background.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote the shader layer: a warm glow that follows the cursor over a dark navy gradient with a light noise texture. It has not been compiled or rendered, because no Powermove tools were attached to this run. The shader reads iMouse as pixels, or as uv if the values are 0–1. With no mouse input, the glow drifts on its own so rendered frames don't look empty. Settings like glow size, strength, falloff, drift, the three colors and mouse-following on/off are all Inspector controls.
